values.summary: Implemented purpose-separated distributed certificates with bounded rotation, revocation, expiry, atomic compromise fencing, and durable fail-closed authority.
actual_changes: Added five non-interchangeable certificate purposes with Ed25519 root verification and bounded validity.
Added monotonic rotation with bounded overlap and one identity per quorum vote.
Added durable revocation, atomic identity compromise fencing, restart validation, and resource ceilings.
Added exact positive, negative, recovery, corruption, and capacity regressions.

actual_validation.purpose: Run the exact distributed certificate regression target with nonzero selection.
Fail closed on stale or tampered WP-04.02 proof.
